runs.text: When is it a good idea to write a kind of thing as a particular case of another, with
Inheriting says what something is, and works well with stable particular cases. When traits combine, the particular cases multiply and composing scales better.
When the child is a particular case of the parent and there are no traits that combine.

justification.text: A cashier is an employee; if there are no combinations, the hierarchy does not explode.
Sharing code is not enough: if the child is not a particular case, composing suits better.

runs.text: When an object holds another inside.

justification.text: That is composing: a product has an offer.
